title: Signal: pubspec without an SDK constraint
scope: A pubspec.yaml file that declares a pubspec that declares no Dart SDK range.
limitations: It matches a pubspec that declares no Dart SDK range in the parsed pubspec.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pubspec.yaml that mentions a pubspec that declares no Dart SDK range in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
